services.name: Day Sail - Hourly
services.desc: Must Call To Book! 3-6 Hours About We have multiple locations to choose from throughout the summer including East Tawas, Mackinaw City, and Mackinac Island. Our crewed yacht charters would love to help you build a summer memory. Whether you are looking to swim, stand up paddle or Kiteboard in pristine landscapes, propose on Tawas Bay or under the Mackinac Bridge, or create a unique, private experience for a bachelorette or birthday party, we'd love to hear from you, drop us a line! Please note that these are private charters only with a rate of Three to Six hours • All ages welcome! • Up to 6 Guests!

services.name: Sunset Sail - Mackinaw City
services.desc: Enjoy the sunset! 2 Hours About Climb aboard our luxury catamaran and enjoy the magnificent sunsets around the Mighty Mackinac Bridge that Lake Huron and Lake Michigan offer. Get to know the crew, listen to music and dance as the sun sinks low and the stars come out. services.name: Day Sail - Mackinaw City
services.desc: Come sail with us! 2.5 Hours About Enjoy the spacious area of our luxury catamaran and take in the scenery of the Mighty Mackinac Bridge with your loved one or friends. Relax to the sound of waves as we sail, and maybe swim or enjoy stand up paddle boarding on the pristine waters of Lake Huron. Lean into adventure this summer season with a little imagination aboard Athina.
